cases.sentence: Вскоре после этого Иисус пошел в город, называемый Наин, с Ним были Его ученики и много ___.
cases.explain: «других людей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

cases.sentence: Вместе с ней из города выходила ___.
cases.explain: «большая толпа» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

cases.sentence: Иисус как раз в это время исцелил множество людей от болезней, недугов, от одержимости ___ и многим слепым даровал зрение.
cases.explain: «злыми духами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

cases.explain: «мягкие одежды» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.

cases.sentence: Нет, те, кто одевается в дорогую одежду и живет в роскоши, находятся в ___.
cases.explain: «царских дворцах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.

cases.sentence: В это время одна женщина из этого города, которая была известна как грешница, узнав, что Иисус обедает в доме фарисея, принесла туда алебастровый кувшин, в котором было очень дорогое ___.
cases.explain: «ароматическое масло» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

cases.sentence: Она стала вытирать Ему ноги своими волосами, целовала их и натирала ___.
cases.explain: «ароматическим маслом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

cases.sentence: Ты не помазал Мне голову маслом, а она драгоценным ___ помазала Мне ноги.
cases.explain: «ароматическим маслом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

cases.sentence: Но ___, возлежащие за столом, начали переговариваться:
cases.explain: «другие гости» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
